quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[0]: The &aMultiblock Printer&f and &aMultiblock Validator&f are two tools that can help you build new structures and validate broken multiblocks.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[2]: The following pages will teach you how to use each item.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[4]: The &aMultiblock Printer&f supports only certain structures, which you can find in &eJEI&r by searching “&aMultiblock Printer&r” and checking for the "&aⓘ&f Compatible" tag.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[6]: Once you've gatherered the required blocks and cleared enough space for the multiblock, place down the &bController&r and Right-click it with the &aMultiblock Printer&r.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[8]: It will place blocks automatically using items from your inventory.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[10]: If something blocks block placement or an item can’t be found in your inventory, the &aMultiblock Printer&f stops working and shows an error explaining the issue.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[12]: The &aMultiblock Validator&f helps diagnose and maintain &eCustom Machinery&r multiblocks.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[14]: Using it on a &bCustom Machinery Controller&r shows all &aInstalled Multiblock Modules&f.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[16]: It can also re-align the World Engine automatically.
quest.2140EAC255C3EA09.quest_desc[18]: You can also reset all multiblock cores. This action will &c&n&lNOT&r&c&n refund any lost items&r to errored cores, meaning any items in those cores will be effectively voided.
